replacements.RÚBRICA → CEGADO → JUICIOS INDEPENDIENTE: RUBRIC → BLINDING → INDEPENDENT JUDGMENTS → DISAGREEMENT → EVIDENCE
replacements.Una evaluación humana fiable necesita un: Reliable human evaluation needs a protocol, not just votes
replacements.El objetivo es convertir juicios humanos: The goal is to turn human judgments into an auditable signal: define what is judged, reduce irrelevant cues, observe disagreement, and preserve it by dimension and segment.
replacements.Protocolo de evaluación humana desde la: Human-evaluation protocol from the rubric to reporting by dimension and segment
replacements.Define la dimensión antes de mirar respu: Define the dimension before looking at answers
replacements.Separar criterios evita que una impresió: Separating criteria prevents a global impression from hiding which property passed or failed.
replacements.Mismo caso, identidad oculta y orden ale: Same case, hidden identity, randomized order
replacements.El cegado reduce pistas de identidad y p: Blinding reduces identity and position cues; it does not turn a subjective criterion into objective truth.
replacements.La doble anotación en un subconjunto per: Double annotation on a subset lets you measure agreement without duplicating every case.
replacements.El conflicto es información sobre el pro: Conflict is information about the protocol
replacements.adjudica casos críticos y mejora rúbrica: adjudicate critical cases and improve rubric / examples
replacements.Reporta algo más útil que una media: Report something more useful than an average
replacements.Reduce la carga de asignar una escala ab: Reduces the burden of assigning an absolute scale, but only measures the preference defined by the task
replacements.Chatbot Arena usa batallas anónimas y al: Chatbot Arena uses anonymous, randomized battles to collect pairwise preferences. That design is useful for preference; it does not replace an external source of truth when correctness can be verified.
replacements.ocultar identidad y aleatorizar el orden: hiding identity and randomizing order reduces presentation bias; it does not remove subjectivity from the criterion
replacements.el acuerdo sirve para diagnosticar el pr: agreement helps diagnose the protocol; a poorly defined criterion or shared bias can produce consensus
replacements.si existe una comprobación externa, ejec: when an external check exists, run it; fluency or style should not replace factual evidence
